source_evidence: D281~20:54–20:58 Station Kestrel after Helmed Horror destroyed and inner iron vault door still CLOSED. Armor is hollow with fine interlocking arcane inscriptions, no ordinary clockwork, body, obvious key, removable control, or accessible compartment; whether a magical command exists cannot be determined beyond those physical findings, previous failed Arcana8/DC15 (with revoked MP expenditure) not overwritten. Guard KN-G6 remains unconscious stable0/11, wrists/ankles bound with V-owned50ft rope behind laboratory cabinets, ordinary guard equipment/no obvious vault key or special authorization found by a look; no ownership transfer, hand-seized items or body violence, lab west door relocked. Door Investigation genuined20 FACE20+Investigation3=23 vsDC15 SUCCESS, without Tactical Assessment because success needed no limited resource; 2014 nat20 not automatic success for skills but total23>15. Visible accessible conventional mechanical keyhole runs a reinforced locking bolt/bar inside its protected stone jamb; the bar is coupled to the lock, not proven a separate secret release. Ordinary original iron-lock Thieves' Tools DC15 remains available if V CHOOSES a picking attempt, but no pick, open, forcing, door damage or trap disarm attempted and no guarantee of trap absence. Door remains CLOSED/locked; contents unknown. The earlier assertion that V could not establish whether bar links to keyhole is replaced by earned closer successful inspection. Existing environmental time advancement of few minutes (20:54→~20:58) without any Fenar attack/damage ends her 2014 Rage active condition normally (not due to 10min maximum), but used Rage charges remain2/4, Shift3/3, MP6/6, FenarHP51/59AC14 and Bestial Soul CLIMB40 unchanged; VHP48/48 AC19, Sup1/4, Psi0/6, MP7/7, PastLife0/3, PsiRecovery0/1, ActionSurge0/1, SecondWind1/1 and equipment unchanged. KN-M1 mage still stable0/40 bound/gagged lab table and expected wake~22:17; other KN-G2/G3/G5 and KN-M2 apprentice stable unconscious unchanged; site old bell continues with admin KN-G1 and front gate KN-G4 still active and no further contact.
